name: template-fuzzy-combo
description: Fuzzy combobox on the categorised Save modal. Opens Save, types a partial project query into the free-text Project field, and verifies the dropdown shows fuzzy-ranked existing values plus an 'Add …' custom row last.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: open-save-modal
steps.click: button[title="Save this apartment to your library (with its category)"]

steps.name: type-partial-query
steps.eval: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Project name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, 'seran'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.focus(); })()

steps.name: verify-fuzzy-and-custom
steps.failMessage: Expected a fuzzy match for Serangoon plus a trailing 'Add seran' custom row
